answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on ephemeral memory consumption bounds that render bulk automated spawning intractable. The summit holds work receipts rather than names, so the opal of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a analytical prose structured with explicit logical operators and causality register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the beacon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
